genesis.title: Genesis: Beginnings
genesis.description: Travel from the dawn of creation to the death of Joseph. These origin stories lay the foundation for every major theme that follows in Scripture.

creation.title: Creation & Choice
creation.description: God speaks the cosmos into being and crowns it with image‑bearing humans. In Eden they are invited to trust the Creator's wisdom or define good and evil for themselves.

cainAbel.title: Cain, Abel
cainAbel.description: Jealousy drives the first murder and violence multiplies across the earth. Even in judgment, God marks Cain with mercy and preserves a faithful remnant.

noahFlood.title: Noah & the Flood
noahFlood.description: Waters of judgment cleanse a corrupt world, yet grace carries Noah's family to a new start. A rainbow covenant promises that God's long‑range plan is redemption, not destruction.

babel.title: Nations & Babel
babel.description: Humanity scatters into distinct peoples after a prideful tower‑project. Out of the confusion God calls one man, Abram, to become a blessing to all nations.

abrahamCall.title: Abraham's Call
abrahamCall.description: God establishes a binding promise of land, descendants, and global blessing. Abraham's faith is tested repeatedly yet ultimately credited as righteousness.

isaacFamily.title: Isaac's Family
isaacFamily.description: A miraculous son carries the covenant line forward. His marriage to Rebekah ensures the promise continues despite human weakness.

jacobEsau.title: Jacob & Esau
jacobEsau.description: Twin brothers struggle for birthright and blessing, revealing God's sovereign choice. Jacob experiences both deception and divine encounter on his way out of Canaan.

jacobReturn.title: Jacob's Sojourn & Return
jacobReturn.description: Years of exile, marriage, and family drama refine Jacob's character. A mysterious night‑wrestling match prepares him to face Esau and reclaim his new name—Israel.

josephDreams.title: Joseph: Dreams to Dungeon
josephDreams.description: Joseph's coat, dreams, and betrayal plunge him into slavery and prison. Yet every setback becomes a setup for God's providential rise to Egyptian power.

josephForgiveness.title: Joseph: Famine & Forgiveness
josephForgiveness.description: Global famine reunites Joseph with the brothers who wronged him. Tears of reconciliation show how God turns evil intentions into saving purposes.

jacobBlesses.title: Jacob Blesses & Joseph Dies
jacobBlesses.description: A dying patriarch blesses twelve sons and foretells their futures. Joseph's final act of faith is requesting his bones be carried to the promised land.

exodus.title: Exodus: Deliverance & Law
exodus.description: Witness God break Israel's chains and forge a nation by covenant at Sinai. Liberation is not merely freedom from Pharaoh but freedom for worship and holy living.

bondage.title: Bondage & Moses' Birth
bondage.description: A new pharaoh enslaves Israel and orders infant sons killed. God preserves baby Moses and appears in a burning bush to recruit him as deliverer.

plagues.title: Nine Plagues & Final Warning
plagues.description: Nine escalating plagues expose Egypt's gods as powerless. Pharaoh's last refusal after the plague‑warning of chapter 11 hardens his heart for the climactic judgment to come.

passover.title: Passover Night
passover.description: Blood on door‑frames turns judgment into deliverance. The Passover lamb establishes a perpetual memorial of redemption and foreshadows a greater rescue still to come.

redSea.title: Red Sea & Victory Song
redSea.description: A pillar of cloud leads the march; walls of water open and then close over pursuing armies. Miriam's tambourine rings as the people sing, "The LORD is my strength and my song."
